I agree with marking them as effectively untestable for *full* verification due to the pose/sling, but the visible portions do not contradict the class definition. The `topology_boundary_auditor` confirmed the main subject (gown) has a clean mask (0.95 confidence), suggesting the gown itself is structurally coherent despite the background chaos. The Router underestimated the severity of the background fence; the 'melting' of the mesh is a classic AI failure mode that significantly degrades image realism, warranting a higher penalty than just 'structural collapse'.
